title: headcount-sync-interview-loop-prep-scratchpad-maya
content:
Goal: prep for headcount sync + interview loop debrief (eng IC hiring, 3 roles: infra eng x2, frontend eng x1)

Quick context:
- Budget sign-off expected by end of Mar; need final role prioritization this week for Dedicated hiring plan.
- Interview loop ran 2026-02-22 to 2026-02-24 (panel of 4 interviewers each). Two strong candidates for infra role A (CAND-184, CAND-197); one strong frontend candidate (CAND-203).
- Some inconsistent scoring on system design round — need calibration.

Prep notes for sync (30m):
- Status summary (1 slide): open reqs / top candidates / salary band ask / interview feedback highlights
- Ask for: approval to extend offers for CAND-197 (infra) and CAND-203 (frontend) pending comp check
- If budget constrained: propose prioritizing infra A over infra B (impact: latency projects, roadmap dependency)
- Risks: headcount freeze timeline uncertain; check with finance on potential hiring window (ask finance in meeting)

Interview debrief bullets (to go through with panel leads):
- CAND-197 (infra): strong latency intuition, solid kernel/ops experience, flagged: limited product org experience. Recommended next: hire committee + manager final (1:1).
- CAND-184 (infra): excellent long-term architecture thinking, weaker on async debugging task. Recommendation: keep as backup (strong culture fit).
- CAND-203 (frontend): strong ownership and product sense, some mismatch on React v18 specifics, but ramp plan acceptable. Recommended: extend offer at band 3 with 10% relocation stipend option.

Open questions / follow-ups (assign):
- @Ava: pull comp band comps + suggested offer numbers for each candidate (due EOD Thu)
- @Ryan: confirm manager availability for final 1:1s next week (Mon/Tue windows)
- @Priya: draft offer template language emphasizing remote-first + relocation option
- @Maya: sync with finance re: Q2 hiring runway and headcount freeze triggers; add to FYI for execs

Debrief action items (owner -> due):
- Collate interviewer notes into one doc (Ava) -> 2026-03-02
- Run candidate ref-check for CAND-197 (Priya) -> 2026-03-03
- Prepare offer numbers and approval packet for budget sign-off (Ava + Maya) -> 2026-03-04
- Schedule hire committee review (Maya) -> target 2026-03-05

Calibration checklist (short):
- Normalize scores: use rubric mapping (technical(0-5), ownership(0-5), communication(0-5), culture-add(0-5)) -> ask panel leads to re-score if variance >2
- Pull examples from interview recordings for discrepant questions (note timestamps)

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize product priorities: infra hires unblock low-latency infra work which reduces per-token cost (tie to cost-savings narrative)
- Tradeoff: small delay on frontend hire might be acceptable if infra headcount accelerates throughput improvements
- Keep pay bands flexible within 10% to close top candidates quickly

Misc scratchpad (things to remember):
- Candidate logistics: CAND-197 can start ~30 days after offer; has pending visa paperwork? check with Priya
- Diversity goals: ensure final slate meets shortlisting guidance (at least 1 underrepresented candidate per panel where possible)
- Link to raw interviewer notes: confluence:Headcount-Q2-2026#interviews

Meeting agenda (10m prep for Maya):
1) 5m quick status + ask
2) 10m discuss prioritization if budget constrained
3) 5m confirm next steps + owners

End-of-doc reminders:
- Keep this doc as scratchpad — finalize summary slide after syncing with Ava and Ryan
- Upload final candidate packet to Confluence and tag execs once offer numbers are approved

Unresolved questions to surface in sync:
- Exact hiring freeze threshold from finance (headcount or $)
- Any hiring pause planned for Dedicated infra teams in Apr/May (impacts ramp)
